Got a text about expiring reward points? Look closer: problems: stampSay 'Your points are fine' is not supported. The FTC says only that 'some' of these messages are fake and tells people to check whether their points 'are really expiring.' Telling viewers their points are definitely fine could mislead someone whose points really are expiring. The line should say the text is bait and that viewers should check their points themselves. (rewrite 1 of 2)

Got a text about expiring reward points? Look closer: problems: Flag 3 ('Fake points warning') circles the sender line, but the source says nothing about the sender or phone number being a warning sign. The spoken line is supported, but circling the sender implies the number itself is a tell. Retarget this flag to the message body or drop the sender circle. (rewrite 2 of 2)
